'''Crispin Freeman''' is an American actor and former script adaptor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is currently affiliated with Arlene Thornton and Associates.

==Biography==
Crispin Freeman was born in {{wp|Chicago}}, {{wp|Illinois}}, U.S. and began his career as a voice actor in 1997. Freeman started working on {{aniseries|PTS}} as a script adaptor during the first two seasons of the show. Years later, Freeman joined the cast as a voice actor in {{aniseries|HZ}}, where he voiced [[Friede]].
